notes.subject: stelim pikinini
notes.rationale: ושכלה em i tok long lostim pikinini (olsem wanpela mama i lusim pikinini bilong em), ol i tanim long 'bereave'

notes.subject: ושכלה אתכם
notes.rationale: KJV/JPS 'rob you of your children' vs YLT 'bereaved you' — mak ⟨את⟩ i pointim yupela, tasol wok i paitim pikinini

translation: Na bai mi salim ⟨את⟩ ol animal bilong gaden long yupela, na bai ol i stelim pikinini bilong yupela, na bai ol i kotim olgeta ⟨את⟩ ol animal bilong lukautim bilong yupela, na bai ol i ritim yupela i go daun, na rot bilong yupela bai i stap nating.
